mapper.select: SELECT id, cust_id, subject_type, subject_id, related_emp_id, related_org_id, relation_type, ratio, effective_date, expiry_date, source_system, source_batch_id, refreshed_at, refresh_status, created_time FROM MARKETING_CUSTOMER_PERFORMANCE_REL_SNAPSHOT WHERE cust_id = #{custId} AND refresh_status = 'SUCCESS' AND (effective_date IS NULL OR effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (expiry_date IS NULL OR expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
